description: How to be told when it snows, without this server writing anything: the powder-alert threshold and schedule, the e-mail, webhook (Standard Webhooks, signed), Atom and iCal channels, the per-resort public Atom feed, the webhook payload contract, and the manage page where a person registers a destination. Pass a slug to get that resort's feed URL.

slug.description: Optional: a resort slug, to fill in its public Atom feed URL.

name: get_alert_options

how.description: What a person or agent does to use it.

url.description: Where to go, or a URL template.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the result was generated.

manageUrl.description: Where a person subscribes and registers webhooks; e-mail verified, no password.

thresholdInches.description: New snow in 24 h (measured) or storm total (forecast) that fires an alert.

writes.description: This tool never subscribes anyone; it only explains how.
